entities.page_title: Student Visa - German Missions in Pakistan
entities.title: Application procedure for student visa
entities.summary: Student visa applications for Germany are processed digitally via the Consular Services Portal, requiring document upload and an initial screening before appointment scheduling. The consular section notes high application volumes and advises applicants to submit complete, accurate documents to avoid delays.
required_documents: Documents generated after completing the interactive questionnaire on the Consular Services Portal
Past degree certificates (school, bachelor or past master degrees)
Proof of payment of tuition fees (if applicable to the course of study)
Proof of acceptance of late arrival at university or enrollment letter for next semester (recommended to expedite processing)
application_process: Register for an appointment via the Federal Foreign Office's Consular Services Portal
Complete the interactive questionnaire to generate the list of required documents
Documents undergo first screening by a visa officer
Applicant is informed of next step: either an appointment notification or a request for further/corrected documents
Karachi applicants (Sindh and Baluchistan) submit applications via the same Consular Services Portal link
important_notes: Incomplete applications result in delayed processing
High volume of student visa applications is currently being processed, exceeding capacity
Some mandatory documents are currently marked as optional on the system due to technical difficulties, but must still be submitted from the outset or registration will remain halted
Applicants are asked to refrain from further inquiries as this reduces processing capacity
Applications are processed in the order received
